entry.title: Read rendered MMIS dates from dojovalue when input value is empty
entry.description: A Maximo date cell may have an empty HTML input value while dojovalue carries a Unix millisecond timestamp. For MMIS in Asia/Taipei, convert that timestamp to the local YYYY/MM/DD date before treating the field as empty.
applicable_when: Parsing read-only Maximo table date cells with datatype 3 and an empty value
advantages: Matches the browser-rendered date without browser automation
disadvantages: Assumes the MMIS site timezone is Asia/Taipei
recommended_when: A recorded DOM or HTTP response shows a blank date value but a populated dojovalue
notes: Confirmed against the 2026-10-02 repair-work-order DOM, screenshot and live HTTP query: dojovalue 1790697600000 renders as 2026/09/30.
Prefer an explicit nonempty input value when present; preserve a truly empty value as empty.
